scope: Post-raid outcome and settlement reconciliation; not full feature or production acceptance

assertions: Starting loadout snapshot contains the actual committed weapon
Actual operator settlement and weapon loss
Insurance explanation rendered in report DOM

regressions.insurance: Successful extraction no longer cancels a claim for insured equipment left behind; test covers active-raid waiting, closure, one return and duplicate prevention. Actually returned equipment still needs no claim.
regressions.injuryRouting: An initial implementation reused damage kind for machine/operator attribution and failed an existing injury test. Attribution now uses a separate source field; existing injury rules and full suite pass.
regressions.rollback: Failed checkpoint rolls back report, reward and actor settlement; retry settles once. Pending outcome reason survives serialization/restore.

limitations: Insurance status is a historical settlement snapshot; current claim status is in the base insurance panel.
The ledger covers settlement only, not all purchases, sales or later contract claims.
Original equipment is recorded separately from final carried losses; consumed or voluntarily abandoned items are not mislabeled as death drops.
Older records are retained without invented death causes or financial detail.
The loopback browser scenario checks actual settlement and DOM content, not human readability, real-network acceptance or every device.
The full release acceptance list remains open in RELEASE_ACCEPTANCE.md.
